title: Variant stability index and autopin for quantized models
creator: Priya Menon
description: Introduce a reproducible Variant Stability Index (VSI) to score quantized model variants (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ) across accuracy, output drift, latency stability, and failure modes. Use VSI to drive an automated pinning (autopin) workflow that promotes low-risk variants to 'stable' pins and surfaces borderline or regressing variants for human review. This reduces manual review load for common safe variants while preserving guardrails for regressions.
acceptance_criteria: VSI calculated for every quantized variant ingestion (nightly and on-demand) and stored as a telemetry metric
Autopin rule engine that promotes a candidate variant to a stable pin when VSI <= 0.12 and no regression flags present
Audit trail and email/console notifications for autopromote actions and exceptions
Canary rollout of autopinned variants on 5% shadow traffic followed by 24h smoke check before full promotion
Regression alerts triggered if any production latency or accuracy SLOs degrade by >5% after autopromotion
implementation_notes: VSI composition: weighted combination of relative eval delta (weighted 0.45), embedding cosine drift (0.20), token-level edit distance per 1k tokens (0.15), 95th percentile latency jitter normalized by baseline (0.10), and failure/error-rate delta (0.10)
Use existing evaluation harness from /evals/quant-harness to compute relative eval deltas on canonical prompt set (1k prompts covering generation, summarization, and instruction-following)
Leverage Telemetry Ingest (kafka topic quant-metrics) to emit VSI and component signals; add a new avro schema version for vsi_score and vsi_components
Autopin engine: standalone service (stateless) that reads candidate variant artifacts, queries latest VSI and recent regression flags, and writes pin decisions to the pin-registry (pin-store API)
Safety: autopin must mark variant metadata with 'autopinned_by=VSI-v1' and attach a rollback window (72h) during which automatic rollback is allowed if regression is detected
Canary workflow: create a push rule to route 5% of real traffic (via shadow routing) to autopinned variant for 24h; collect end-to-end metrics and comparator baseline
Expose VSI and autopin decisions in Console: per-variant timeline, tooltip explaining components, and ability to manually override autopin
Telemetry thresholds and contracts: define metric contracts for stable baseline (stored in config repo) and implement a contract checker in the ingestion pipeline
Add unit and e2e tests for vsi computation, edge-cases where inputs are missing, and guaranteed monotonicity for metrics aggregated over windows
test_plan: Unit tests for each VSI component transformation with synthetic inputs
Integration test that runs full vsi computation on a snapshot of 50 historical variants and verifies expected score distribution
Staging canary with synthetic traffic for autopin engine; verify that autopromote writes expected pin-store entries and emits audit events
Run a 24h shadow canary in staging against model-sim cluster and confirm no false-positive regressions before limited prod rollout
Load test the autopin service with burst ingestion (500 variants/hour) to validate rate limits and backpressure behavior
